name: Hope Legendary Domain
body:
The domain of hope is one of filling those around you with joy, morale and high expectations of the future. As a cleric of the hope domain, you are likely to be community oriented and one that buoys their peers in times of strife. You are an optimistic individual and your faith gives you the drive to keep going even if things seem bleak..

Divine Skill: Knowledge (local)

Lasting Hope (Su)

When you cast a spell with the hope descriptor on a target other than yourself, you may spend 1 point of faith as a swift action to modify it with the Extend Spell feat. This does not increase their level or casting time. If a creature attempts a save against the spell, this ability has no effect.

Reassuring Presence (Su)

At 4th level, you and all allies within 10 feet of you gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against despair and fear effects. You may spend a faith point as an immediate action to increase this bonus to half your cleric level (minimum +3) for 1 round. Additionally, you gain a +2 on Diplomacy checks to alleviate despair or improve an NPC’s attitude. This Diplomacy bonus increases by 1 at 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter, to a maximum of +5 at 17th level.

Unshakable Assurance (Ex)

At 8th level, your faith and hope is unshakable. You gain immunity to despair and fear spells and effects.

Domain Spells: 1st-lesser good hope, 2nd-encouragement, 3rd–good hope, 4th-greater path of glory, 5th-shining beacon, 6th-greater good hope, 7th-hymn of peace, 8th–euphoric tranquility, 9th-beacon of life

Doctrine of Bravery

You bring out the courageous aspects of yourself and your allies. There is always hope for success.

Emboldening Presence (Su)

When spending a point of faith with your reassuring presence ability. In addition to the increased save bonus, you provide the benefits of the spell heroism to any affected allies for the round.

Unshakable Presence (Su)

Your presence keeps your allies from succumbing to fear or hopelessness. If they are within the area of your reassuring presence, they are immune to despair and fear spells and effects as well.

Doctrine of Camaraderie

You bring people together in a collective belief in triumph. When you work together, nothing can stop you.

Encouraged Cooperation (Su)

When using your reassuring presence ability, the bonus provided improves flanking and aid another benefits by 1/2 the bonus provided to the saving throws. Additionally, the radius of the aura extends to 20 feet.

Collective Reaction (Su)

At 16th level you may spend 1 point of faith as an immediate action to bolster yourself and your allies within 30 feet. If you or your allies are subject to a spell or effect with a saving throw, you and your allies all roll the save. The highest roll is treated as the roll for any of those affected. You or the affected allies still apply their own modifiers to the saving throw result.
